name: agnews_server_post_primary_ablation_v1
purpose: Decompose the compound AG News routed-versus-anchor result on a newly frozen, client-disjoint, train-derived evaluation holdout.

already_observed: AG News official-test post-observation replication seeds 145-149
AG News development results used during method construction
TREC and GSM8K results reported in the current draft
Development metrics from 11 completed records under invalidated protocol e53e3b4b
A reconstruction showing 303 holdout IDs were allocated to at least one prior AG server client across seeds 42-44 and 142-149
not_observed_at_freeze: Any aggregate evaluation prediction or metric on the exact 4,000-record secondary holdout
Any valid result under the final protocol hash and final runner hash
chronology.classification: post-primary run-disjoint same-task resampling ablation; not globally untouched data, preregistered, externally timestamped, or an independent task replication

instrumentation_repair.failure: The no-client arm attempted to form a teacher-weight audit list using division by zero.
instrumentation_repair.evidence_observed: No JSON record or evaluation metric was written; the exception occurred during first-round audit-record construction.
instrumentation_repair.repair: Represent the absent teacher ensemble with an empty teacher_weights list.

chronology_repair.issue: The first protocol wrote a nominal frozen_utc of 13:45 even though its filesystem mtime was 13:31 and valid development processes began from 13:31 onward.
chronology_repair.action: Stopped the matrix, retained all logs, invalidated all four completed JSON records, and refroze with the actual refreeze time before accepting any result under this protocol hash.
chronology_repair.claim_effect: No performance value from the invalidated records is used for tuning, gating, inference, or the paper.

prior_training_exposure_repair.issue: The secondary records are excluded from clients in the new runner, but the first evidence wording incorrectly implied global historical non-exposure.
prior_training_exposure_repair.action: Stopped the matrix at 11 of 12 completed records, retained 23 JSON/log artifacts, invalidated every completed record, changed the evidence label and phase name, and refroze before any secondary-holdout evaluation.
prior_training_exposure_repair.final_scope: The split is evaluation-disjoint from every client in this runner, but not globally untouched across the research history.

data.isolation: The runner excludes the complete holdout ID set from every client allocation in every arm and seed. The official AG News test is not opened.

development.gate: Implementation-only: all 12 records must validate; C and D must have identical per-seed mixtures; no overlap may occur; all metrics are reported regardless of direction. No performance threshold or tuning is permitted.

secondary_holdout.execution_rule: Run the complete 10-by-4 matrix regardless of development directions; never add seeds based on observed results.

analysis.confidence_intervals: two-sided 95% Student-t intervals over paired seed differences
analysis.multiplicity: one Holm family containing exactly the three adjacent accuracy contrasts
analysis.sensitivity: exact two-sided paired sign-flip p-values computed from integer correct-count differences
prohibited: No fourth test for the routed-minus-anchor net contrast
No equivalence claim from a non-significant contrast
No component-specific attribution because severe jointly changes conflict and off-task rates
No attribution to routing scores alone because the complete intervention changes set size and composition

evidence_boundaries: The holdout records were selected after primary results were observed; this is post-primary evidence.
The evaluation records are disjoint from anchors, development, and all clients in this runner, but originate from the AG News training distribution.
A reconstruction found that 303 evaluation IDs had appeared in at least one prior server-client allocation; the split is not globally untouched.
This is not a new task, external replication, preregistration, or proof of broad robustness.
The audit-only clean/conflict/off-task composition is never used as a routing input.
Off-task membership is identifiable through the explicit task interface; clean versus conflict identity is not provided to the router.
The public-anchor-only arm omits the client path here; the older AG primary strict control instead executed shadow clients with zero distillation weight.
No privacy, secure aggregation, or deployment-efficiency claim is authorized.
